status: PARTIAL PASS - direction-reversal check has 0/14 FALSE on known labels but only 4/9 recall
hypothesis: The H17 V-shape criterion is biased toward throwing evidence (H28 finding: 6/12 adjacent candidates had a real throw visible but no real catch). H30 hypothesizes that requiring the SOURCE's last position to be above the V-apex (in image coords, smaller y) AND the source's trajectory to be descending (last y > first y) will reject the throw-only false positives without rejecting real catch+throws.

approach.v1_velocity_rejected: v1 used source-tail and target-head velocity dot products with apex direction. Rejected because real catch+throws often have short source/target tracklets where velocity is dominated by noise.
approach.v2_positional: v2 uses positional checks: src_above (source end y < apex y - 20), tgt_above (target start y < apex y - 20), both_above (both conditions), src_descending (source end y > source first y + 10), tgt_ascending (target start y < target last y - 10).
approach.evaluation: Apply H30 v2 to 151 H17 strict positives, correlate with known visual QA labels (H17/H20/H24/H28).

key_finding: The src_above + src_descending check has PERFECT precision (0/14 FALSE) but only 4/9 REAL recall on the deduplicated known-label set. It is a useful PRECISION-OPTIMIZED filter: rejects all known false positives while keeping 4/9 of the known reals. Applied to the H17 strict pool of 108 unique candidates, it admits 16 (15%), filtering out 92 (85%) of the strict pool.
interpretation: H30 src_above + src_descending is a precision-optimized filter. It correctly identifies candidates where the source has been DESCENDING (y increasing = ball falling in image coords) and is currently ABOVE the V-apex (closer to top of image, meaning at higher real-world position = approaching the hand).

The 5 known REALs missed by H30 src_above+desc (54->57, 56->57, 13->15, 29->33, 56->58 -> 4) are mostly cases where the source's first y is already past the descending threshold (the source's tracklet is too short, or the source is at the apex). The 4 found are cases where the source has a clear approach trajectory.

The 0 false positives on known labels suggests the check is robust: it correctly rejects the 'throw-only' false positives from H28 (which had src_above=True but src_descending=False for 39->46, 24->26, 1->6, 62->65, 67->72).

The 16-candidate H30-KEPT pool is a useful STRICT SUBSET of the H20-KEPT pool (115 candidates). Of the 15 H20-AND-H30-KEPT candidates, 5 are already in the known label set (4 REAL + 1 PARTIAL), and 10 are NEW candidates that haven't been visually QA'd.
negative_findings: v1 (velocity-based) was rejected. The dot product approach is too noisy for short tracklets.
h30_pass (at least one of src_above or tgt_above) has 7/9 REAL recall but 11/14 FALSE. It is NOT a precision filter, just a sanity check.
both_above (both src_above AND tgt_above) has 3/9 REAL but 2/14 FALSE. It is a precision filter (3/3 = 100% on the small sample) but only catches a third of REALs.
tgt_above + tgt_ascending has 6/9 REAL but 3/14 FALSE. Less strict than src_above+desc but worse precision.
conclusion: H30 src_above + src_descending is a useful precision-optimized filter. It correctly identifies 4/9 known REAL catch+throws while rejecting 14/14 known FALSE positives. Applied to the H17 strict pool, it admits 16 candidates that should be high-precision. H31 (next experiment) should visually QA the 10 NEW H20-AND-H30-KEPT candidates to confirm the high precision and characterize H30's recall on a larger sample.
recommendation: h7v3plus2 (H26) remains the recommended chain set. H30 is a precision-optimized filter that, when combined with H20, admits 15 high-precision candidates (vs 115 H20-KEPT). H31 visual QA is needed to confirm the precision claim on a larger sample.
